My son lost his electric power for a short time and I gifted him my first Weber Q. Later, I bought my current Q.  I cook directly on the grill and also use me cast iron cookware.  Grilling outside in the hot summertime keeps my kitchen cooler and I love it.  Being a single grandma, I don't need anything bigger and its perfect for me.   I can't imagine how I lost the ignition button off my grill.  Squirrels?  I called Weber's customer service line to order a new one because there was no ignition button on the parts page. Results.ReviewText:
I am not ordinarily in the habit of leaving product reviews, but occasionally a product comes along that is so well-made that it would not be fair if such a product were to go unmentioned. This is such a product.

My hat is off to the person or team that designed this grill. Such smart design!!

Start with the cooking grates:  they are porcelain-enameled cast-iron so they build up a nice heat such that you can get those beautiful grate lines on your burgers and hot dogs, and yet are easy to clean when all is said and done. Another smart-design aspect of the grates is that they do not allow drippings from the food to fall directly on to the burner thus avoiding the potential for clogging the small holes where the propane burns.

One should know that while the grill appears small, there is plenty of surface area to cook upon. I can easily get a dozen or more burgers cooking simultaneously, or two or three dozen hot dogs/bratwursts.

The fold-in side tables are such a smart idea! They are covered and protected (by the lid) during transport where they also help to stabilize the cooking grates, yet provide an instant work space when you're ready to grill.

The bottom half of the grill is bowl-shaped with an opening at the bottom. This bowl design channels drippings to the center whereupon they fall through the opening and into a catch pan which accommodates disposable drip pans. If you need to clean the interior of the grill, there is adequate space between the burner and the grill wall to allow you to wipe down the grill wall. Again, smartly designed.

Let me conclude by noting that I bought this grill for the purpose of tailgating at my son's AAU baseball games. I also bought the portable cart that goes with it (another great product by the way). I wanted to be able to cook a burger for him and any of his teammates who were hungry. Long story short, I used this grill weekend after weekend to feed my son and his team. It performed like a champion and I was able to easily cook enough burgers to feed the team between games.

Simply put, I love this grill. Well done, Weber!!
Results.Title: Very smart design!!!
